bio: Professor of Biostatistics Biostatistics, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Biostatistics I am interested in the development of adaptive clinical trial designs. My research includes the study of algorithms and methodologies for the analysis of data generated by adaptive trials. I am also particularly interested in Bayesian nonparametrics, a great source of modeling opportunity in biomedical applications as well as, both computational and theoretical problems. Incorporating data from multiple ongoing trials for Bayesian two-stage phase II single-arm studies. Halabi S, Choi T, Garrett-Mayer E, Schilsky RL, Trippa L. Clin Trials 2025 PMID: 40838464
